settings.title: Settings

general.storage: API keys are stored in the operating system keychain. Sessions, costs and settings live in a local SQLite database in pumr's app data folder.

providers.futureHint: More providers (API key or OAuth) are planned.

settings.baseUrlHint: Only change this if you use a proxy or a compatible gateway.
settings.handoverModelHint: Model used to summarize a session when handing it over. Leave empty to use the current session's model.

workspace.foldersHint: The assistant can read and write these folders without asking. The active project is always allowed.

directory.title: MCP Servers
directory.subtitle: {{ count }} Model Context Protocol servers
directory.officialTooltip: Listed in the official Model Context Protocol registry, with a verified owner namespace.
directory.dockerTooltip: Published in the Docker MCP catalog and run through Docker.
directory.installHint: Copies an mcpServers config you can paste into your MCP settings.

mcp.autoDiscoveryHint: Scans standard locations used by Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, opencode, Devin and others.
mcp.foldersHint: pumr scans these folders and their subfolders for MCP config files.
mcp.phaseNote: Reference an MCP server in the composer with @mcp to connect it and expose its tools.
mcp.registryHint: Search the official Model Context Protocol registry and copy a server into your MCP config.
mcp.verifiedTooltip: The server's registry namespace is verified — its name is owned by the domain or GitHub account that published it.
mcp.verifiedOnlyHint: Show only servers whose registry namespace is verified. Turn off to include unverified third-party entries.
mcp.recommendedHint: Popular servers from the official registry. Pick one to search for it, then copy its config.

github.name: GitHub

braveSearch.name: Brave Search

sentry.description: Inspect errors and issues in Sentry.

skills.autoDiscoveryHint: Scans standard locations used by Claude Code, opencode, Codex and others.
skills.foldersHint: pumr looks for folders that contain a SKILL.md file.
skills.phaseNote: Reference a skill in the composer with @skill to load its instructions into the chat.
skills.marketplacesHint: Add a Claude-style marketplace (a git repo with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json), review its plugins and install their skills locally.
skills.reservedNameTooltip: This name is reserved for official use, so the marketplace may be impersonating an official source.
skills.noPlugins: This marketplace has no installable plugins.
skills.installedHint: Skills installed from marketplaces are available to the agent and are always discovered, even with auto-discovery off.
skills.verifiedTooltip: Verified means pumr curates this marketplace and its checkout matches a pinned commit, so its contents cannot change silently.
skills.trustedTooltip: Trusted means you added this marketplace yourself, so installing from it is allowed.
skills.unverifiedTooltip: Unverified means pumr has not reviewed this marketplace. Installing from it requires allowing unverified sources.
skills.verifiedOnlyHint: Verified marketplaces match a curated pinned commit; trusted ones are the URLs you added yourself. Turn off to allow installing from any marketplace.
skills.recommendedHint: Community catalogs reviewed for this list. Adding one clones it locally; review its plugins before installing.

settings.apiKeyHint: Stored in your operating system keychain, never in plain text.
settings.systemPromptHint: Used for every new session unless a session defines its own.
settings.systemPromptCustomizedHint: A customized system prompt is active for new sessions.
settings.systemPromptWarning: You are changing the system prompt. This can significantly alter the assistant's behavior and may break tool use, safety checks or output formatting. Only change it if you know what you are doing.
settings.securityPromptHint: Adds guidance on secrets, input validation, least privilege and safe dependencies.
settings.testingPromptHint: Adds guidance on writing focused, deterministic tests and running them before finishing.
settings.architecturePromptHint: Adds guidance on module boundaries, responsibilities and maintainable design.
settings.replyLanguageHint: Added to the system prompt so the assistant replies in this language. Default leaves the model's own language.
settings.themeHint: Applied immediately and saved together with your settings.
settings.highContrastHint: Strengthens muted text, borders and surfaces for improved readability. Recommended for low vision or bright environments.

customTheme.title: Custom colors
customTheme.hint: Pick your own palette. The base switches between light and dark rendering.

background.title: App background
background.hint: Pick a built-in backdrop or use your own image. It sits behind the glass panels and follows your theme.

settings.glassOpacityHint: How opaque the frosted panels are. Lower values make them clearer so the app background shows through.
settings.keepAwakeHint: Prevents the screen from locking and the computer from sleeping while the agent or a subagent is running.
settings.tabsMultilineHint: When enabled, open tabs wrap onto additional rows. When disabled, tabs stay on one row and a scrollbar appears once there is no space left.

chat.pasteWordLimitHint: Pasted text with more words than this is collapsed into an editable pill in the composer. Set to 0 to always paste text inline.

sounds.title: Notification sounds
sounds.hint: Play a short sound when the agent finishes, asks for permission or stops with an error.
sounds.builtinHint: Built-in sounds are synthesised in the app and are free to use. Custom files are played from their original location.
sounds.doneHint: Played when the agent completes a task.
sounds.permissionHint: Played when the agent needs your approval or asks a question.
sounds.errorHint: Played when the agent stops because of an error.

hotkeys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
hotkeys.hint: Click a shortcut and press the key combination you want to use. Press Escape to cancel. Most shortcuts require a modifier; Delete and Backspace work on their own.
hotkeys.closeTabHint: Closes the currently active session tab.
hotkeys.newSessionHint: Creates a new session in the active project.
hotkeys.deleteSessionHint: Deletes the session highlighted in the sidebar.
hotkeys.windowToggleHint: Global shortcut that brings pumr to the active screen. Enable it under Window.

window.title: Window summoning
window.hint: Summon pumr to the screen you are working on with a global shortcut, even when another app is focused. Press it again to hide or minimize.
window.enableHint: Registers a system-wide shortcut. Disabled by default so pumr never claims a key you did not choose.
window.hotkeyHint: Click and press the key combination. Function keys work without a modifier; on macOS you may need to hold Fn.
window.behaviourHint: What the shortcut does when the window is already in front.
window.fillScreenHint: Make the summoned window fill the active monitor instead of keeping its previous size.
window.zoomHint: Scales the whole interface. Shortcut: Ctrl/⌘ + + to zoom in, Ctrl/⌘ + - to zoom out, Ctrl/⌘ + 0 to reset.

settings.extraFolders: Additional folders the assistant may access
settings.extraFoldersHint: One absolute path per line. Used in the tools phase.
settings.contextLimit: Context messages sent to the model
settings.contextLimitHint: 0 means unlimited. Older messages are trimmed first.
settings.maxToolIterationsHint: How many consecutive tool calls the agent may make before it pauses and asks you to continue. The limit is a safety valve: it stops a model that gets stuck in a loop from running forever and burning tokens. 35 is a good default; raise it for long, multi-step tasks.
settings.autoContinueAllSessionsHint: When a session reaches the tool-call limit, keep going automatically instead of pausing. This removes the loop safety net, so a stuck agent may run until you stop it. You can also toggle this from the chat when a limit is reached.
settings.subagentModelHint: Model used for subagents. Leave empty to use the session's model.
settings.compactionModelHint: Model used to summarise long conversations. Leave empty to use the session's model.
settings.promptCachingHint: Mark the stable prompt prefix as cacheable so providers that support caching bill cached input tokens at a lower rate.
settings.mcpProgressiveDisclosureHint: When many MCP tools are connected, expose a tool_search/mcp_invoke pair instead of inlining every schema to save context. Small tool sets are always inlined.
settings.fileAccessRulesHint: Control which files the assistant may discover and read. User exemptions always win over every rule below.
settings.ignoreGitignoredHint: The assistant skips files that git ignores, such as build output, caches and local artifacts.
settings.scanGeneratedFiles: Allow scanning build files and dependencies
settings.scanGeneratedFilesHint: Exception to the .gitignore rule: also scan generated and dependency folders such as node_modules, dist, target, coverage or vendor, plus logs, caches and minified assets.
settings.ignoreLocalDatabasesHint: Skip local database files such as .sqlite, .db, .realm, .mdb or .accdb.
settings.ignoreEnvFilesHint: Skip .env files while keeping example, sample and template files readable.
settings.ignoreEnvFilesWarning: Warning: turning this off lets the assistant read .env files, which usually contain API keys, database passwords and access tokens. Only disable this if you trust the configured model and provider.
settings.fileIgnoreExemptionsHint: Glob patterns that the assistant may always read, even if covered by .gitignore, database or environment rules.
settings.advancedIgnoreHint: Fine-tune every built-in format. Entries follow their group switch above unless you override them here; your changes are remembered.
settings.commandRulesHint: Exact rules match command text literally; glob rules use wildcards. Both can coexist with the same text. Safety checks still apply.
settings.noCommandRules: No command rules yet. Use "allow always" in a permission prompt to create one.
settings.websiteRulesHint: Websites the assistant may visit, with its web tools or with commands such as curl, git and ssh. Deny rules win over allow rules; a plain domain also covers its subdomains. Use "allow always" or "deny always" in a permission prompt to create one.
settings.permissionPromptsHint: Choose what the main allow button does by default. Allow once approves a single request; allow for this session remembers folder access until the app restarts.
settings.autoApproveHint: Skip prompts for work the assistant can prove is safe. Dangerous commands, inline code, package downloads, websites that are not allowed yet, paths outside the project and sensitive files always ask.
settings.autoApproveReadOnlyHint: Allow inspection commands such as ls, grep and git status without asking.
settings.autoApprovePackageScriptsHint: Allow pnpm, npm, yarn, bun, ng, make and similar tools when nothing points outside the project.
settings.autoApproveProjectExecutablesHint: Allow executables inside the project, such as ./node_modules/.bin/ng, without asking every time.
settings.autoApproveProjectCommandsHint: Allow any non-dangerous command whose paths stay inside the project. Dangerous commands, inline code, package downloads, websites that are not allowed yet, sensitive files and anything outside still ask.

permissionPreset.strictHint: Only read-only commands run without asking.
permissionPreset.balancedHint: Read-only commands, package managers, build runners and project executables run without asking.
permissionPreset.autonomousHint: Every non-dangerous command inside the project runs without asking.
permissionPreset.autonomousWarning: Autonomous trusts this project: its scripts, Makefiles and executables can do anything without a prompt. Inline code, package downloads, websites that are not allowed yet, dangerous commands and anything outside the project still ask.

permission.ruleHint: For example: grep * matches any grep command, pnpm test matches exactly that command.
permission.siteRuleHint: For example: docs.rs allows that site, *.github.com allows all its subdomains.
permission.siteRuleInvalid: This rule doesn't cover {{ host }} or is too broad, so {{ host }} will be saved instead.

scope.title: Rule scope
scope.hint: Choose how broadly this rule applies.

folderScope.title: Whitelist folder
folderScope.hint: Adds the folder and everything below it to the always-allowed folders.

hostScope.title: Allow website
hostScope.hint: Adds the website and its subdomains to the allowed websites.

option.chat: Yes, and don't ask again in this chat for
option.session: Yes, and don't ask again until restart for

permission.keyboardHint: Press 1–{{ count }} or use ↑ ↓ and Enter · Esc denies

url.queryWarning: This address carries a lot of data in its query string. Make sure it contains nothing private before you allow it.

tooltip.deny: Deny this request and every other request waiting in this chat.
tooltip.denyAlways: Deny and save a deny rule to your settings. Other requests waiting in this chat are denied too.
tooltip.allowSession: Remembered in every chat until the app restarts.
tooltip.allowChat: Command rules are remembered for this chat and its subagents; folders and websites until the app restarts.
tooltip.allowAlways: Saved to your settings and applies to every chat.
